newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds lower in USDA aftershock.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds lower in USDA aftershock.

text.p: UK meals and feeds prices fell on Wednesday following new contact lows in Chicago overnight.
The U.S. market was still reeling on Tuesday following the USDA report which put soybeans plantings at the highest for 15 years, although there were signs that it was beginning to look oversold.
U.K. sellers reduced their prices for soymeal by as much as 6.50 stg a tonne, but brokers said buyers were not falling over themselves to get on the market.
"There has been some business going on, but both sides seem to be shell shocked after the recent falls in Chicago," said one broker.
In the remainder of the market rapemeal and sunflower meal sellers were down around one stg while most other sectors were unchanged.
